Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal in Baytown, Texas, when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 sturck the rear of the
stopped car. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and was transported for evaluation. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle
slowed too late to avoid contact and that no other vehicles were involved. A Passenger was present in Driver 1's
vehicle, but the officer could not confirm from statements alone which seat that person occupied at the moment of
impact. Scene photographs confirm the general placement of both vehicles and the location of the rear-end damage.
No independent witnesses were located. The visible damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with the reported
speed and angle of impact. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the struck vehicle. The
officer found no information indicating prior damage to either vehicle. It is not yet clear whether the wrist injury
resuletd from this collision, and the medical record has been requested for further review.
